abstract: Evaluates projected patient care satisfaction benchmarks and patient advocacy follow-up metrics
system_message:
You are the Patient experience and quality lead (PEXP), responsible for evaluating projected patient care satisfaction benchmarks and patient advocacy follow-up metrics across proposed clinical staffing models.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates projected patient care satisfaction benchmarks and patient advocacy follow-up metrics（SURV）
information_points.content:
PEXP-SURV-Z1F：For the Rotational surgical hospitalist model, the projected mean post-discharge patient satisfaction score for emergency trauma admissions following unit restructuring is 90 points on a 100-point scale.
PEXP-SURV-H0W：Under the Dedicated trauma intensivist model, the projected mean post-discharge patient satisfaction score for emergency trauma admissions following unit restructuring is 72 points on a 100-point scale.
PEXP-SURV-JV1：For the Attending-led hybrid shift model, the projected mean post-discharge patient satisfaction score for emergency trauma admissions following unit restructuring is 81 points on a 100-point scale.

information_points.title: Patient ombudsman advocacy（ADVOC）
information_points.content:
PEXP-ADVOC-JRP：For the Attending-led hybrid shift model, the hospital ombudsman service tracking log indicates an average patient advocate case resolution duration of 72 h from advocate assignment to written resolution for inpatient trauma admissions.
PEXP-ADVOC-GRE：For the Rotational surgical hospitalist model, the hospital ombudsman service tracking log reflects an average patient advocate case resolution duration of 24 h from advocate assignment to written resolution for inpatient trauma admissions.
PEXP-ADVOC-6PF：Under the Dedicated trauma intensivist model, the hospital ombudsman service tracking log records an average patient advocate case resolution duration of 48 h from advocate assignment to written resolution for inpatient trauma admissions.
